title: qfer-preflight validation report, schema version 1
description: The document produced by `qfer-preflight check --format json`. Schema version 1 is the first published shape. Compatibility policy: adding an optional field or a new enum value is a minor change and bumps the minor version; removing a field, renaming a field, changing a type, or tightening a constraint that existing reports satisfy is breaking and bumps the major version. The `schema_version` integer in the report names the major version it conforms to.
minorVersionHistory: 1.1: adds the optional `evaluation` ledger, one entry per rule and column, saying how many rows each rule judged on this file. Optional rather than required, because a report written by an earlier version has no such field and requiring it would retroactively invalidate documents this schema already described.

1.2: adds the optional `code_lists` object, present only on a run given `--naics-list`. It records that QP018 was evaluated against a NAICS code list the caller supplied rather than a published one, with that file's path, SHA-256, distinct code count and line count. Absent rather than null on every other run, so a report produced without the flag is byte for byte the report this tool has always written. The codes themselves are never in it: the Commission declined to publish that list, and a report is a document a filer forwards.

findings.description: Occurrences: every row carrying a finding, before any merging.

finding_lines.description: Entries in the findings array after identical findings were merged.

evaluation.description: What each rule read on this file, one entry per rule and per column it touches. A measurement of the run: it carries no severity, cites no document and moves no verdict. Added at minor version 1.1 and therefore optional: a report produced before it exists is still a valid version 1 report.

code_lists.description: Code sets this tool did not publish, handed in by the caller for one run. Present only when such a list was supplied AND accepted. A run given a list that was refused carries no entry here and states the refusal as the rule's not-evaluated reason instead, so "no list was supplied" and "a list was supplied and refused" never read the same. Added at minor version 1.2.

cell.description: Spreadsheet reference for the offending value, for example D2.

occurrences.description: Present only when the finding was merged from more than one row.

example_rows.description: Present only when the finding was merged.

last_row.description: Present only when the finding was merged.

column.description: The column this entry counts, or null when the rule reads the submission as an object or when this form publishes no column it reads. `subject` and `zero_reason` say which.

subject.description: The unit `offered` counts. Without it, judged 1 of 1 file could not be told from a rule that stopped after the first row.

evaluated.description: Whether the rule was applied at all on this run, matching its presence in `rules_evaluated`. A rule can be evaluated and still have judged nothing, which is the distinction this ledger exists to publish.

offered.description: Units handed to this rule. Always equal to judged plus exempt plus blocked. Equal to `counts.rows_read` for every row rule except QP004, whose subject includes the blank rows rows_read excludes.

judged.description: Units the rule reached a verdict on, whether or not it produced a finding.

exempt.description: Units the rule's own published applicability does not reach, so it declined to reach a verdict.

blocked.description: Units an earlier rule left unreadable. The rule that stopped them is named in blocked_by.

zero_reason.description: Present exactly when judged is 0, and absent otherwise. A zero with no reason beside it reads as a clean result, which is the failure this ledger was written to prevent.

blocked_by.description: The rule that stopped this one. Present when blocked is above zero, or when zero_reason is blocked_by.

code.description: An identifier from the closed ADVISORY_CODES table. Advisories carry no severity and cite no document.

suppliedNaicsList.description: The NAICS code list QP018 was evaluated against on this run. The Commission does not publish its "Valid NAICS codes" list and this tool ships none; this one came from the person who ran the tool, and every QP018 finding in the report rests on that file and on nothing else.

provenance.description: The only value this field takes. A published code set would not need one, and none of the tables in codes.py appears here.

path.description: The path exactly as the caller wrote it, never resolved to an absolute path: a report is forwarded, and a directory layout is not part of a filing.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file's bytes as read, before any decoding. This is what identifies the list when two reports disagree.

lines.description: Lines read, which exceeds `codes` when the file repeats one.
